PASS under PMAT-633. I read `docs/audits/quorum-PMAT-7509.prompt.md` in full (all 3,598 lines / 150,116 bytes) and audited every module against PMAT-7509 and `aprender-viz` invariants:

- **Acceptance criteria satisfied**: All four spherical Snyder projections (`AlbersEqualArea`, composite `AlbersUsa`, `Mercator`, `Equirectangular`) implement `forward` and `inverse` with domain/finiteness refusal (`GeoError`), backed by 256-case round-trip and out-of-domain `proptest` suites plus committed 3-point reference tables per projection (`projection_tests.rs`). GeoJSON and TopoJSON readers (`reader.rs`) decode committed fixtures (`shapes.geojson`, `shapes.topojson`) to identical rings and refuse unsupported/malformed/amplified inputs (`MAX_EXPANDED_POSITIONS = 4_000_000`, `checked_add`, bitwise `!index` safe at `i64::MIN`). `douglas_peucker` (iterative stack, `hypot` unit-vector distance, `MAX_COORDINATE = 1e150`) and `visvalingam` satisfy endpoint/subsequence/`tol = 0` identity properties and match hand-derived reference polylines (`simplify_tests.rs`). Even-odd scanline fill and `fill-rule="evenodd"` SVG path generation (`fill.rs`, `Coord::Geo`, `Geom::polygon`) leave hole pixels unfilled and ring pixels filled in both framebuffer and SVG, and match `three_shapes.svg` byte-for-byte with coordinate sensitivity (`fill_tests.rs`, `plot_tests.rs`).
- **Gates & security**: Recorded orchestrator test gates pass (`1132 passed, 0 failed` for `aprender-viz --features geo --lib`; `2434 passed, 0 failed` for `aprender-contracts --lib`; `cargo fmt` clean). No test asserts the opposite of the ticket, and no security defect is present.
- **Non-blocking author follow-ups (`blocking_class: none`)**: Five follow-ups are recorded in `findings[]`, most notably three `clippy::disallowed_methods` calls (`f64::ln`, `f64::powi`, `f64::exp`) in `src/geo/projection.rs` combined with missing `--features geo` wiring in `ci/explicit-test-commands.d/` and clippy, plus missing `GeomType::Polygon`/`Coord::Geo` refusals in `BuiltGGPlot::layout()` and non-geo `draw_frame`.
- **Tree witness**: `$(git rev-parse --git-dir)/paiml-lane-witness` (`/home/noah/src/aprender/.git/worktrees/wt-7522q/paiml-lane-witness`) is absent in this workspace, so `tree_witness` is omitted.

findings.claim: `mercator_y` (`projection.rs:149`), `AlbersEqualArea::inverse` (`projection.rs:236`), and `Mercator::inverse` (`projection.rs:393`) call stdlib `f64::ln`, `f64::powi`, and `f64::exp`, which are banned by `crates/aprender-viz/.clippy.toml:71-88` under crate-level `#![deny(clippy::disallowed_methods)]` (`crates/aprender-viz/src/lib.rs:58`, APEX-001 EV-2a rule 5). Measured via `grep` across `crates/aprender-viz/src/`: these three lines are the only banned-method calls in the crate and will fail `cargo clippy -p aprender-viz --features geo --lib` (and `.sin()`/`.cos()`/`.tan()`/`.asin()`/`.atan()`/`.atan2()` in `projection.rs` also use platform libm rather than `libm::*` on the `coord_geo` render path).
findings.fix: Replace `.ln()` with `libm::log(...)`, `.exp()` with `libm::exp(...)`, and `.powi(2)` with direct multiplication `let u = rho * self.n / self.radius; u * u` (and consider routing trig/inverse-trig calls through `libm` for cross-host render determinism).

findings.claim: The new `geo` feature (`Cargo.toml:159`) is not wired into CI tests or clippy: it is absent from `full` (`Cargo.toml:182`), no fragment in `ci/explicit-test-commands.d/` runs `cargo test -p aprender-viz --lib --features geo geo::` (unlike `729-aprender-viz-plot-cli-unit.cmd` for `plot-cli`), and `scripts/ci/libm-ban-live.sh:111,181` runs `cargo clippy -p aprender-viz --lib` without `--features geo`. Measured across `.github/workflows/`, `ci/`, and `scripts/`: all five `geo::*_tests` modules are currently dark in CI.
findings.fix: Add a `ci/explicit-test-commands.d/NNN-aprender-viz-geo-unit.cmd` fragment running `cargo test -p aprender-viz --lib --features geo geo::` and include `--features geo` (or `geo` in `full`) in clippy coverage after fixing the `disallowed_methods` calls.

findings.claim: Asymmetric grammar refusals for `Geom::polygon` and `Coord::geo`: (1) `Geom::polygon(features)` under default `Coord::cartesian()` causes `geo_plot::draw` (`src/grammar/geo_plot.rs:34-36`) to return `Ok(None)` and `render_layer` (`src/grammar/ggplot.rs:1070-1096`) to silently draw a blank plot instead of returning `Err(Error::UnsupportedCoord(...))` or `Err(Error::UnsupportedLayer(...))`; and (2) `BuiltGGPlot::layout()` (`src/grammar/ggplot.rs:879-905`) was not updated alongside `dist.rs`, `path.rs`, `rects.rs`, and `scale_spec.rs` to refuse `GeomType::Polygon` or `Coord::Geo` on the plain `geom_point`/`geom_polygon` path, returning empty or unprojected Cartesian scales.
findings.fix: Refuse `GeomType::Polygon` when `coord` is not `Coord::Geo` in `draw_frame`/`to_svg`, and refuse `GeomType::Polygon` and `Coord::Geo` in `BuiltGGPlot::layout()` with typed `Error::UnsupportedLayer` / `Error::UnsupportedCoord` errors.

findings.claim: `wrap180` (`(deg + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0`) and `Projection::inverse` (`projection.rs:82`) document a half-open longitude range `[-180, 180)`, but for `deg` in `[-180.0 - 2.84e-14, -180.0)`, `(deg + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0)` adds `360.0` to a tiny negative remainder, rounds to `360.0` in IEEE-754 `f64`, and returns `+180.0`.
findings.fix: Clamp or wrap `+180.0` back to `-180.0` (e.g. `if w >= 180.0 { -180.0 } else { w }`) so the half-open `[-180, 180)` postcondition holds for all finite inputs.

findings.claim: `docs/roadmaps/entries/PMAT-7509.yaml:5` (and `docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml:28014`) still has `status: planned` with unchecked `[ ]` acceptance criteria, and `docs/audits/impl-PMAT-7509-receipt.md:3,25` cites `code head 1af0ecfe6` and `Contract bindings wait for MAP-0 to merge` whereas `HEAD` (`a19f8c9ff`) has now merged `origin/main` (`e994e617e`, MAP-0 `contracts/aprender-viz-map-projection-v1.yaml`).
findings.fix: Update ticket status/checkboxes on completion, refresh the receipt head SHA, and wire `aprender-viz-map-projection-v1.yaml` bindings in follow-up now that MAP-0 is on `main`.

findings.fix: Skip the raster `<image>` layer or skip raster polygon drawing when rendering `coord_geo` to SVG if pure vector output is desired.

findings.claim: `albers_polar_band_latitude_error_below_1e_minus_5` only asserts latitude round-trip accuracy (`let (_, lat2) = proj.inverse(x, y)`), ignoring longitude even though `albers_snyder()` has `std1 = 29.5, std2 = 45.5` where `rho(90) > 0` and longitude remains well-defined at the pole.
findings.fix: Assert `lon_gap(lon, lon2) < 1e-5` alongside latitude in `albers_polar_band_latitude_error_below_1e_minus_5` when neither standard parallel is at a pole.

findings.fix: Update status and check off completed acceptance criteria on merge.
